reviews.text:
This is a dog grooming salon located right next to Daitabashi Station.

I heard that they have someone who is very skilled at nail trimming, so I went there even though it's a bit far.

My dog ​​weighs 18kg.

Last time, at the animal hospital, even with the veterinarian and two groomers working together, it was a real struggle, and one of the groomers even got injured... He wasn't trying to bite, he was just trying to escape, but they could barely trim his nails, and his dewclaws were curled up, which was really frustrating.

However, here, they trimmed his nails so skillfully while stroking his head. And they even filed them!

I had told them that just trimming the dewclaws on his front paws would be enough, so I didn't expect them to go to such lengths.

I was truly relieved.

While I was holding my dog, his dewclaws became sharp and scratched me, so I rushed him in because I was worried he might injure someone at a client's home.

I didn't have an appointment, but they kindly accepted me, which was a great help!

During the nail trimming, they spoke to my dog ​​a lot to make him feel at ease.

They were very efficient, and my dog ​​didn't struggle at all...
It may just be nail trimming, but they cut his nails shorter and rounder than at my usual salon, and did a great job.

I would definitely like to use their services again!

The shop had a great atmosphere, and all the staff were very kind. And most importantly, I was extremely satisfied with the skill! Previously, even when I brought photos, the results were always questionable, but this place exceeded my expectations. Thank you so much! I'll definitely book another appointment next time.
I always struggle to decide on a haircut style, but they always listen carefully to my requests and give me a cute finish 🐾 …

They always give my dog ​​a cute and beautiful finish.

Their Bichon Frise grooming skills are amazing, and I can leave my dog ​​there with complete peace of mind.

The shop is very clean and has a lovely atmosphere ✨
They always leave my dog's fur fluffy and silky, and I'm happy they send me photos of the grooming process ☺️
The groomers are all kind and affectionate, so my dog ​​is always excited and wags her tail when we arrive at the shop 🐶💓
Above all, the grooming is quick, which is a great help!!

Thank you for your continued support.

Ms. Saito, who has been taking care of my child since she was a baby, always cuts her hair so beautifully.

She takes pictures of my child during shampooing and after the haircut, which I always look forward to!

Thank you again for everything.

I've been a customer since the salon first opened.

The shop has a lovely atmosphere, and thanks to the staff who greeted me every time I passed by on my walk before the opening, my dog ​​quickly became attached to them.

The photos they take at the salon clearly show how relaxed my dog ​​is.

The results are wonderfully fluffy, and they make my dog's bottom look like a beautiful loaf of bread – I'm so proud of it! They also point out areas of concern on my dog's body, which helps me manage his health properly.

I look forward to continuing to use your services.

I always take my dog ​​in for shampooing. They leave him/her fur fluffy and beautiful.

My dog ​​was diagnosed with cancer after bleeding during anal gland expression. He/she underwent surgery and is now healthy. I don't think we would have found it on our own, so I'm really glad we bring him/her in for regular shampooing.
